translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Wuowi mariek winjo puonj wuon mare,
to ngʼat ma wangʼe tek ok winj wach kikwere.
Ngʼat makare yudo pok maber kaluwore gi gik mowacho,
to ngʼatno ma ok ja-adiera nigi gombo mar miero.
Ngʼatno morito dhoge orito ngimane,
to ngʼatno ma wuoyo karodho wach biro dhiyo e kethruok.
Jasamuoyo dwaro gimoro gi chunye duto to ok oyud gimoro,
to jakinda yudo gik moko duto modwaro.
Ngʼat makare mon kod gima ok adiera,
to joricho kelo wichkuot kod dwanyruok.
Tim makare rito ngʼat mobidhore,
timbe maricho to tieko jaricho.
Ngʼat moro wuondore ni en ja-mwandu,
to adiera oonge gimoro;
to ngʼat machielo wuondore ni en jachan,
to adiera en gi mwandu mangʼeny.
Mwandu ngʼato sa moro nyalo reso ngimane,
to jochan onge gima bwogo.
Ler mar ngʼat makare rieny maler,
to taya mar ngʼat marach inego.
Sunga nywolo mana dhawo,
to rieko iyudo kuom jogo moyie puonj.
Pesa moyud e yo ma ok kare lal nono,
to ngʼat makano pesa matin matin miyo omedore.
Gima igeno mobudho miyo chuny bedo matuo,
to gima igeno motimore en yath mar ngima.
Ngʼat ma jaro puonj biro yudo pokne,
to ngʼat moluoro chik imiyo pok maber.
Puonj mar ngʼat mariek en soko mar ngima
ma reso ngʼato e obadho mag tho.
Bedo gi winjo kelo luor,
to yor ngʼato ma ok ja-adier tek.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato mariek timo gik moko kuom ngʼeyo,
to ngʼat mofuwo nyiso mana fupe.
Jaote marach donjo e chandruok,
to jaote modimbore kelo konyruok.
Ngʼat modagi siem nwangʼo dhier kod wichkuot,
to ngʼato angʼata mawinjo kikwere to yudo duongʼ.
Geno mochopi en gima mit ne chuny,
to joma ofuwo ok dwar aa e richo.
Ngʼat mawuotho gi ngʼama riek bedo mariek,
to osiep joma ofuwo hinyore.
Chandruok luwo jaricho,
to mwandu e ohand ngʼat makare.
Ngʼat maber weyo mwandu ne nyithind nyithinde,
to mwandu jaricho okan ni joma kare.
Puoth ngʼat ma jachan sa moro nyalo nyago chiemo mangʼeny,
to tim ma ok kare tiekogi duto.
Ngʼat ma ok ti kod kede kuom chwado wuode, omon kod wuode,
to ngʼat mohere bedo motangʼ mondo orieye.
Joma kare chiemo moromo kaka chunygi dwaro,
to ii ngʼat marach nigi kech.
